summary.vi: Be going to diễn tả một kế hoạch hoặc dự định đã có trước khi nói, hoặc một dự đoán dựa trên bằng chứng ngay trước mắt.
summary.en: Be going to expresses a plan or intention that was already decided before speaking, or a prediction based on evidence you can see now.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn đã quyết định làm gì đó trước lúc nói: I'm going to call her tonight.
when_to_use.en: When you decided to do something before speaking: I'm going to call her tonight.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn thấy bằng chứng rõ ràng và dự đoán điều sắp xảy ra: Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
when_to_use.en: When you see clear evidence and predict what is about to happen: Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn nói về một dự định không thực hiện: She isn't going to join us.
when_to_use.en: When you talk about an intention that will not happen: She isn't going to join us.

examples.text: I'm going to visit my grandmother this weekend.

annotation.vi: Kế hoạch đã có trước khi nói.
annotation.en: A plan already made before speaking.

translation.vi: Cuối tuần này tôi định đi thăm bà.
translation.en: I plan to visit my grandmother this weekend.

examples.text: She isn't going to join us.

annotation.vi: Dự định không xảy ra: phủ định bằng isn't.
annotation.en: An intention that will not happen: negative with isn't.

translation.vi: Cô ấy không định tham gia cùng chúng tôi.
translation.en: She does not intend to join us.

examples.text: Are they going to move next month?

annotation.vi: Câu hỏi: đảo be lên trước chủ ngữ.
annotation.en: Question: put be before the subject.

translation.vi: Tháng sau họ có định chuyển nhà không?
translation.en: Do they plan to move next month?

compare.this_example: I'm going to visit my grandmother this weekend.
compare.other_example: I'm meeting my grandmother at the station at 10 a.m. tomorrow.

this_meaning.vi: Kế hoạch hoặc dự định đã có, nhưng chưa chắc đã sắp xếp cụ thể.
this_meaning.en: A plan or intention that exists, but may not be fully arranged yet.

other_meaning.vi: Sự sắp xếp cụ thể đã chốt với người khác, thường có thời gian và địa điểm.
other_meaning.en: A fixed arrangement already agreed with someone, often with a time and place.

compare.this_example: I'm going to buy a laptop next month.
compare.other_example: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.

this_meaning.vi: Quyết định đã có trước khi nói.

other_meaning.vi: Quyết định ngay lúc nói, không chuẩn bị trước.
other_meaning.en: A decision made at the moment of speaking, with no prior plan.

reason.vi: Tiếng Việt không cần động từ be trước động từ chính, nên người học hay bỏ be trong tiếng Anh. Be going to luôn cần am/is/are.
reason.en: Vietnamese does not need a be verb before the main verb, so learners often drop be in English. Be going to always needs am/is/are.

common_mistakes.wrong: I going to buy a phone.
common_mistakes.right: I'm going to buy a phone.

quick_practice.q: We ___ going to travel next week.

explain.vi: Chủ ngữ we đi với are: We are going to travel.
explain.en: The subject we takes are: We are going to travel.

quick_practice.q: She is going to ___ it tomorrow.

explain.vi: Sau going to dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: buy, không chia -s.
explain.en: After going to use the base verb: buy, not the -s form.

quick_practice.q: Look at those clouds! It ___ going to rain.

explain.vi: Chủ ngữ it đi với is: It is going to rain.
explain.en: The subject it takes is: It is going to rain.

prompt.vi: Viết một câu về kế hoạch của bạn cho cuối tuần này, dùng be going to.
prompt.en: Write one sentence about your plan for this weekend, using be going to.

sample.text: I'm going to visit my grandmother this weekend.

corrections.issue: The R5 contrast list includes 'Present perfect vs past simple', which is not one of the required contrast targets for this point.
corrections.fix: Removed that contrast and kept only the two required comparisons: present continuous for arrangements and will for instant decisions.

corrections.issue: The R5 example 'Look! That glass is going to fall.' is grammatical but the level-A2 vocabulary and context are less clear than a weather prediction.
corrections.fix: Replaced it with 'Look at those clouds! It is going to rain.' as the evidence-based prediction example.

corrections.issue: The R5 mistake 'She is going to buys it.' is a real error, but the lesson did not show the negative or question forms in the formula.
corrections.fix: Added negative and question formula variants and examples so the full be going to paradigm is covered.
